subject: Tiếng Anh
style_description: Tiếng Anh có đoạn văn đọc hiểu chung (group_title) cho 3 câu, tiếp theo là 2 câu ngữ pháp riêng, đáp án gạch chân

questions.group_title:
Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.

Renewable energy is energy derived from natural resources that replenish themselves faster than they are consumed. Sunlight and wind are good examples. Renewable energy sources are plentiful and all around us. Fossil fuels - coal, oil and gas - on the other hand, are non-renewable resources that take hundreds of millions of years to form. Generating renewable energy creates far lower emissions than burning fossil fuels.
questions.question: What is the main topic of the passage?
options: A. The advantages of renewable energy
B. The formation of coal and oil
questions.correct_answer: A. The advantages of renewable energy
